segments: Pagan Greek Kings.
the hope of the resurrection.
At this time, a preliminary {OCR?} temple was built among the Gentiles in the city of Gmara {OCR?}:
which Onias had built in Heliopolis, which is in Egypt,
and he performed service in it according to the custom of the Jews.
And in the eighteenth year of Ptolemy Philometor, Demetrius Soter, who was the son of Seleucus, reigned over Syria for twelve years.
For he came from Rome and seized the kingdom of his fathers,
having killed Antiochus Eupator and Lysias, his trusted official.
And in the twentieth year of Ptolemy Philometor, Judah Maccabee arose as the first leader of the Jews.
And from here he held the headship of the priesthood and the kingdom together for three years.
And he drove out Antiochus's general from Judah,
and purified the Temple.
And he was killed in battle by the commander of the army of Demetrius.
And after him arose Jonathan, his brother, for nineteen years,
likewise as high priest and general.
And he gained great renown in battle.
And in the twenty-ninth year of Ptolemy Philometor, Alexander reigned over Syria for ten years,
having killed Demetrius.
He also went to Egypt and subdued it.
And Philometor gave him Cleopatra, his daughter,
and made peace with him.
And Hippolytus said:
that by this was fulfilled that which Daniel said:
"The daughter of the king of the South shall be given to the king of the North."
Theodoret, however, says that by Cleopatra, the daughter of Ptolemy Epiphanes, who was given to Antiochus the Great, peace was made... {OCR?}:
[Ptolemy Euergetes, twenty-]...nine years.
and this is likely.
...and nine.
In his fifth year, there reigned over Syria,
after Alexander,
another Demetrius, for three years.
And in the seventh year of this Euergetes,
after Jonathan arose Simon, high priest and general, for eight years.
He sent a golden shield to Rome,
and the Romans established with him a covenant of friendship on a tablet of bronze.
And he further sent John, his son, against Cendebaeus, general of Antiochus Demetrius {OCR?};
and he defeated him and destroyed his entire army.
